trailhead.label: Murtèl, the middle station of the Corvatsch cable car, the board’s start

cautions: A long descent of over 1,000 m: hard on knees and paws, take breaks.
Steep scree slope below the Fuorcla Surlej junction: lead short and go slowly.
Steep, narrow forest path below the Hahnensee restaurant.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Hahnensee from Murtèl to St. Moritz: Hahnensee, da Murtèl a St. Moritz
textIt.Murtèl, the middle station of the Corvat: Murtèl, la stazione intermedia della funivia del Corvatsch, la partenza della scheda ufficiale
textIt.A long descent of over 1,000 m: hard on: Una lunga discesa di oltre 1.000 m: dura per ginocchia e zampe, fai delle pause.
textIt.Steep scree slope below the Fuorcla Surl: Ripido ghiaione sotto il bivio della Fuorcla Surlej: guinzaglio corto e vai piano.
textIt.Steep, narrow forest path below the Hahn: Sentiero nel bosco ripido e stretto sotto il ristorante Hahnensee.
